profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Washington DC
profile.summary:
Certification - AWS Developer Associate
Language - Typescript | Python
Cloud Infrastructure - AWS | Azure 
Infrastructure as Code - Hashi Corp Terraform | AWS Cloudformation | AWS CDK | Azure ARM
Tools - Kubernetes | Jenkins | JFrog Artifactory | SonarQube | New Relic | and more

positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
• Design, build, and roll out a new way to validate a Github Pull Request against a fleet of environments by deploying a changes, executing prewritten end-to-end test suites, and rolling forward to reset to align with main branch. The Pull Request Orchestrator, written in Typescript, leverages AWS services including API Gateway, DynamoDB, and Lambda functions. A comprehensive test suite for the backend code was written using Cypress for e2e test and jest for local testing. Integrated Zod for enhanced type safety. Organization adaptation to this new workflow to enable full and confident CICD workflow. 
• Perform frontend application platform migration from Netlify to standard AWS static site architecture involving S3, CloudFront, R53, and ACM. Implement organization standard build and deployment pipeline using AWS CDK, CodePipeline, CodeBuild.
• Design, build, and create a Proof of Concept to Github Pull Request custom checks to effectively block from merging without appropriate validation. 
• Create Developer Experience CLI tool to manage dynamodb table data in lower environments. Used AWS CDK (triggers, step function, lambdas, S3 and AWS Glue) to implement infrastructure and npm gluegun to generate CLI interface for end users and provide documentation, training, and ongoing support
• Create a custom AWS account vending workflow to manage AWS organization resources such as AWS accounts, and global tagging using OrgFormation. Implemented using AWS CDK, AWS AppConfig, and Github Action to publish on-merge changes.

positions.title: Infrastructure Engineer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description:
•	Implement CloudBees Core to CMS's (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services) AWS EKS environment with Terraform, configure the Kubernetes clusters with Helm and provide on-going pipeline migration support to developer user groups and provide customized documentation for the operations team
•	Rewrite Infrastructure-as-Code for JFrog Artifactory and Xray with Terraform, configure and provision applications and other supporting components via FluxV2:Gitops Toolkit with Helm, and implement SOPS secret encryption mechanism to enhance and better manage Kubernetes secrets.
•	Configure and monitor the service, EKS, EC2 and other systems with New Relic, Prometheus and Thanos and monitor log streams with Splunk and document outage mitigation strategies

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure
positions.description:
•	Develop new Azure infrastructure in multiple regions using Terraform v0.11 and provide continuous support from an Infrastructure perspective. 
•	Develop and refactor Terraform logic for new application architecture for existing application running in Azure for High Availablity and migrated to use Terrafrom v0.12.
•	Develop tools for cross-platform, cross-environment, or cross-account deployment mechanism
•	Develop infrastructure audit tools using compliance engines such as AWS Config and Azure Policy to fulfill compliance and governance needs

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
•	Manage AWS production application environment and alert teams if actions required
•	Restructure application deployment pipelines to modern artifact-based deployment style
•	Implement AWS System Manager for patch management to production Windows environment 
•	Develop internal workflow tool using NodeJS and Google API to automate repetitive and common G Suite tasks 
•	Lead office relocation project, including office network and cloud phone system configuration and deployment with 0 down time for end users
•	Manage the internal wired and wireless networks and monitor to optimize the network performance
•	Lead IT orientation and training for all departments
•	Plan and Perform company-wide software replacement projects and perform scheduled network equipment firmware updates
•	Function as Desktop Support team lead and resolve or train team to manage escalated tickets from Tier 1 agent

positions.title: Associate System Administrator
positions.description:
•	Maintained and supported internal office systems such as SaaS applications, PBX, and other proprietary technologies
•	Resolved internal technical issues and outages in offices
•	Developed inventory management policy to maintain IT assets, including software licenses
•	Improved and automated internal processes by utilizing Google Apps Script, Node JS, Windows Powershell and batch
•	Automate Google account creation onboarding and offboarding system, rate of error decreased by 100%
•	Developed tool using Google Apps Script hosted in Google Site for internal teams to check email suppression status without going through internal helpdesk and reduced rate of response time to clients by 50%
•	Introduced automated email suppression report for Client services team and saved 120 minutes of work per month

positions.title: Squad Leader
positions.description:
•	Maintained a team of 6 as the squad leader 
•	Operated, maintained and serviced military grade microwave long distance equipment
•	Created and maintained new workflow for the team and awarded best performance team upon DCC inspection

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
- Proactively acknowledged, greeted, and assisted new customers in the store. 
- Provided accurate product information. 
- Communicated with coworkers through telephone and radio system. 
- Built and maintained customers’ satisfaction.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Pyeongchang Organizing Committee for the 2018 Olympic & Paralympic Winter Games
volunteerExperiences.description:
As a Technology Venue Translator, I was involved to translate between engineers and clients in Korean to English or English to Korean, during resolving issues that clients expirenced  throughout their stay in Olympic Village. 
Translation sometimes required professional technological background to explain to clients that they can understand.

projects.title: borkd.dev
projects.description:
Borkd is a zero-latency, edge-rendered status dashboard for modern tech stacks, aggregating real-time health data from SaaS into a single cyberpunk-themed HUD. 

Built using a serverless, decoupled architecture with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Cloudflare Workers, D1 (SQL), and KV to optimize performance and scale efficiently within Cloudflare's free-tier limits.

projects.title: Acti AI
projects.description:
Evaluate current weather of a city with AI

ActiAI is your smart companion for outdoor activities! Powered by advanced weather data and AI, ActiAI helps you decide the best time for running, hiking, picnics, and more. Just enter your location and get instant, easy-to-understand advice on whether the weather is right for your plans.
